title: Newly Single

location.name: Dance & Self — the open-air rooftop club over Atlantis
location.kind: open-air rooftop nightclub on a high-rise, with a soul-only cutaway to an open field on a giant planet
location.real_analog: An open-air rooftop club in central Mexico City (Centro Histórico / Roma), skyline facing the dark ridges of the Sierra de Guadalupe or Ajusco (inferred: the film's Mexico City night material stands in for Atlantis)
near: the DJ Turn Me Up house party he has just left
the Atlantis street and sidewalk directly below (Yet Heard)
unfamiliar mountains on the horizon (later ridden through in Magic Ride)
the PLANET / OPEN FIELD the soul visits (map: PLANET (NEWLY SINGLE), OPEN FIELD)

situation: The POET leaves the house party for an intense open-air rooftop club; dancing is fast, lights flash, time is shifted. His soul leaves his body and floats above, watching the whole of Atlantis lit blue and pink, while the body keeps dancing among strangers. Angels pour cleansing water on the body in the middle of the floor; haze fills the club, the body inhales it and the soul returns. He ends at the rooftop's edge, staring at distant mountains.
weather_light: clear night open to the sky; fast strobes and lasers, blue and pink city glow below, then thickening haze/smoke carved by beams; crescent moon over neon-edged peaks

set_pieces.name: The soul leaves the dancer
set_pieces.what_happens: Mid-dance, a translucent soul rises out of the POET's chest and floats above; the emptied body keeps moving to the beat alone.
lines: & left him on the dance floor—
set_pieces.camera: medium on the dancer under strobe, then a slow crane up following the soul out of frame
set_pieces.position: center of the rooftop dance floor

set_pieces.name: Strangers collide; the last one to leave
set_pieces.what_happens: From the soul's vantage the crowd moves in slow motion, bodies brushing and sparking; the body stays on as the club empties around a lone silhouette.
lines: be the last one to leave,
set_pieces.camera: overhead slow-motion panorama (soul POV), then a 360 orbit around the lone dancer as the floor thins
set_pieces.position: dance floor, seen from above the crowd

set_pieces.name: Soul over Atlantis / the open field at the equator
set_pieces.what_happens: Cutaway: the soul watches the party from far above, top-down over all of Atlantis lit blue and pink; the verse relocates it to an open field under a stalled sun on a much larger, hotter planet.
lines: Now let us put my soul
at the equator of a planet
set_pieces.camera: top-down aerial of the lit city, match-cut to an extreme wide of a curved-horizon prairie with a gas giant in the sky
set_pieces.position: high above the rooftop (sky), and the planet field (soul-space only)

set_pieces.name: Angels' ice-water baptism
set_pieces.what_happens: Cut back to the body in the middle of the club: angels dump cleansing, unfiltered ice water over him while the party continues; he sways in trance.
set_pieces.camera: high angle looking down the water's arc in slow motion; tight on the face as it hits

set_pieces.name: Haze and the soul's return
set_pieces.what_happens: The club fills with haze; the body leans back, inhales the smoke, and the soul streaks back into the chest.
set_pieces.camera: push-in to the chest as the soul re-enters; side light through fog beams
set_pieces.position: edge of the floor, leaning against the subwoofer wall

set_pieces.name: Mountains from the rooftop
set_pieces.what_happens: The POET stares from the rooftop at unfamiliar yet relatable mountains in the distance, reaching toward something just beyond his fingertips.
set_pieces.camera: over-the-shoulder at the parapet, long lens compressing the ridgeline under a crescent moon

arrival.from_previous: He leaves the DJ Turn Me Up house party/poetry reading and goes to the open-air rooftop club (stated); travelling on foot through Atlantis is inferred.

departure.to_next: With no voice-over he leaves the club and walks down the street below, crowds on the sidewalk fawning over him — the street where Yet, Heard begins.

motifs: soul leaving and re-entering the body
being the last one to leave
encoding: The rooftop is Atlantis at its most 'false heaven' (the map's zone gloss: social illusions, techno-faith): the highest, loudest place, where pleasure is an escape with walls and angels of the newest religions baptize a heartbroken body. Only at this height can the soul leave without falling and look down on the whole city; inferred: the mountains he sees from the parapet are the first sight of the way out, which Magic Ride later crosses.
